scope: Fresh mutually independent reference/calibration/test samples on the 32 already studied SRSD tasks. NOT unseen-equation confirmation. H1 is generated ONLY for test.
budget_event: rejection OR any member decline, conditional on H0 and finite training log-space R2 >= 0.99
panel_score: maximum of member empirical CDF anomaly scores; CDFs from valid screened H0 reference records only; ties use strict greater-than rejection
threshold_rule: smallest observed finite calibration score with (strict exceedances + declines)/N_screened <= budget; infeasible when declines alone exceed floor(budget*N)
outcome: legacy upper endpoint: first feature 3*observed training maximum, others training log medians; incomplete outcome is explicitly unavailable, not safe
inference: paired task bootstrap with frozen thresholds; conditional on fitted calibration policy; does not include calibration estimation uncertainty
stop_rule: Run the fixed grid once. No selection or tuning using test outcomes. Protocol changes require a new ID and independent confirmation.
